step1_analysis.description: A set of NMOS transistors acting as independent current sources and a diode-connected load, likely used to bias differential pairs or CML buffers in a high-speed multiplexer or clock synthesizer.

paper_reference.title: A 10-Gb/s 16:1 Multiplexer and 10-GHz Clock Synthesizer in 0.25-m SiGe BiCMOS

I_XM1.description: DC drain current of bias transistor XM1

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square-law model for SKY130 NMOS with Vgs=0.54V.

I_XM2.description: DC drain current of bias transistor XM2

sky130_expected.reasoning: Identical dimensions and bias voltage to XM1.

V_N9.description: Gate-source voltage of diode-connected XM4 at 100uA bias

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated required Vgs to support 100uA reference current.

Power.description: Total static power consumption of the bias network

sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of currents from all branches multiplied by 1.8V supply. XM3 enters triode and draws ~1.8mA due to high Vgs.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC currents and node voltages of the bias network transistors.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Network Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 N8 VB1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 N9 N9 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM3 N1 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 N0 VB2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Supply and Bias Voltages
VDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB1 VB1 0 0.54
VVB2 VB2 0 0.54

* Load Resistors and Current Sources to bias the drains
VR1 VDD N8_R 0
R1 N8_R N8 10k

Iref VDD N9 100u

VR3 VDD N1_R 0
R3 N1_R N1 1k

VR4 VDD N0_R 0
R4 N0_R N0 10k

.control
tran 100p 1n

meas tran I_XM1 avg i(VR1)
meas tran I_XM2 avg i(VR4)
meas tran I_XM3 avg i(VR3)
meas tran V_N9 avg v(n9)
meas tran Power avg -i(VDD)*1.8

print I_XM1 I_XM2 I_XM3 V_N9 Power
quit
.endc
.end
